arcEvents.title: Wildfire emergency
arcEvents.message: Safety shutoffs disconnect 2% of demand and reduce affected generator output. Repairs continue for 2 months.
arcEvents.preview: Extreme fire weather may force safety shutoffs and limit generation.

arcEvents.title: Red-flag warning
arcEvents.message: San Francisco, CA: Review your supply and reserves before the upcoming scenario event.

arcEvents.title: Wildfire restoration complete
arcEvents.message: Safety shutoffs end and repairs finish. Affected generators return to normal.

arcChoices.title: Wildfire preparedness
arcChoices.prompt: Prepare crews and equipment for January's Santa Ana winds, or keep cash.

options.label: Fund preparedness
options.description: Halve customer disconnections and generator output losses in January and February.
options.message: Preparedness halves January–February disconnections and output losses. Repair costs stay the same.

options.label: Keep cash
options.description: Save cash and accept January and February’s full customer disconnections and generator output losses.
options.message: Cash kept. January–February disconnections, output losses and repair costs apply in full.

scenario.name: Adapted grid
scenario.summary: Wildfires are coming to Los Angeles. Prepare for power shutoffs and costly repairs.

briefing.fantasy: Keep Los Angeles supplied while crews repair the grid.
briefing.objective: Keep all connected customers supplied during the January and February 2025 wildfire emergency.
briefing.threat: Safety shutoffs help prevent sparks in high winds. They cut sales and generator output while restoration costs mount.

scenario.endMessage: Power shutoffs and repairs put pressure on both your generators and your budget. How much did you keep in reserve?
